title: A clean Windows account goes from no Python to the /kb-setup steps on the current main, on record
goal: _tools/cleanhost-run.ps1 is run elevated on a fresh Windows account of the project's host at the current origin/main, and kb/_self/reports/windows-fresh-host.md's run sections are replaced with that run: the commit, every step's exit code and last line, and the current suite's counts; the signed-in half (Claude Code sign-in, kb_mcp.py --register-local, MCP calls) stays out of scope.

run: import re,subprocess as s,sys;t=open('kb/_self/reports/windows-fresh-host.md',encoding='utf-8').read();hs=sorted(set(re.findall(r'\b[0-9a-f]{7,40}\b',t)));ok=[h for h in hs if not h.startswith('4d70166f') and s.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor','4d70166f',h],capture_output=True).returncode==0];print('report runs at commits after the suite rewrite 4d70166f:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Is this item worked and proven on the project's Windows 11 host?

notes: Premise (2026-10-07): the report's newest run is at origin/main d10da8d (2026-09-30), before the suite rewrite 4d70166f, so the first check exits 1.
